title: Nuisance-Driven Privacy Cost for Pointwise CATE under Known Uniform Design
banked_reason: The delivered conditional minimax bracket is mathematically sound, but the promised global symbolic frontier remains open below the nuisance elbow; the general referee scored the honest package 6.8 below the 7.2 field floor.
gap_reasons: The promised global symbolic frontier R_n^DP asymp max{R_n^NP,rho_n^priv} is not delivered: this theorem matches only for q >= q_0 or privacy-leading rho_n^priv, leaving the below-elbow privacy-inactive region open.

This open question explicitly retains the missing privacy-transfer/attainment step, so the current artifact supplies a conditional frontier rather than the proposal's claimed full incremental-private-price theorem.

The upper construction also relies essentially on a known exact-uniform design, while the broader bounded-density result is only a transferred lower bound, substantially limiting econometric applicability.
proof_attempt_summary: The run repaired the presolved phase algebra, made the private release and postprocessing map unique, proved the exact-uniform two-sided bracket and matched privacy-leading regimes, and transferred the privacy lower barriers to a bounded-density superclass. The global symbolic equality collapsed in the below-elbow privacy-inactive regime because scalar nonprivate minimax risk provides no replacement-stability certificate. A future retry needs either a genuine stability-aware oracle privatization theorem or an independent same-class nonprivate nuisance converse; the latter was explicitly excluded from this topic.
tldr: On the deliberately restricted class with a known exact-uniform covariate law and bounded observed outcomes, pointwise CATE is a regression-functional hybrid whose pure-central privacy cost has the two scales \(\rho_n^{\mathrm{priv}}=\max\{(n\epsilon_n)^{-\gamma/(\gamma+d)},(n^2\epsilon_n)^{-1/(1+d/\gamma+d/(\alpha+\beta))}\}\). One second-order local estimator and a positive fuzzy Hamming-transport converse yield the matched frontier whenever privacy leads or nuisance smoothness is above the nonprivate elbow. Separately, the exact-uniform class is a subclass of the aligned unknown bounded-density class because its density is one, so both privacy lower barriers also hold on that broader Kennedy-style model. This is a lower-bound transfer only: neither the occupancy-normalized estimator nor the matched phase diagram is claimed beyond exact uniformity. The remaining exact-uniform question is a stability transfer from the attained benchmark to the symbolic nonprivate minimax risk in the privacy-inactive below-elbow region.
gap: Kennedy et al. establish nonprivate pointwise-CATE minimax theory under bounded-density random design and density-qualified attainability conditions, while private CATE papers establish algorithmic privacy guarantees without a pure-central Hölder pointwise minimax frontier. None determines the additional central-private price generated by the product of propensity and outcome-regression errors on a known exact-uniform causal law.
fill: A single \(p^2+3p\)-coordinate Laplace release contains the score block, the upper-triangular Gram block, and their two exact occupancy-normalized corrections; every subsequent symmetry and spectral operation is postprocessing. Boundedness is imposed only on observed outcomes, with causal and kernel bounds derived from consistency, armwise exchangeability, and overlap. A smooth positive exact-uniform fuzzy family supplies singleton cancellation and a componentwise Hamming coupling, while one open symbolic-risk transfer question remains separate from the queued nonprivate converse.
